acquisition_contract.admission: Keep strict trigger parent improvement and every historical parent nondecreasing. Single edits are sufficient when measured sufficient; do not manufacture joint necessity. A new graph is not CoRev.
acquisition_contract.independence: All four conditions start with the exact same real Full seed and receive the same source/feedback. This comparison isolates update mechanisms, not independent end-to-end acquisition. FreeEvolution may use strong joint program and read edits; AllPorts may jointly read all relevant source premises without the three-premise restriction.
acquisition_contract.learning_object: Update the already-acquired source-grounded exception-applicability judgment and its legal consequence when the current contract differs.
acquisition_contract.legal_modules: The existing graph separates an actual recipient-disclosure permission from the effect of the general nondisclosure obligation. Preserve this useful boundary where valid, but do not force two changes, fabricate defects, or split one record into extra skills.
acquisition_contract.reads: READ may acquire supported source-rule parameters. The learned procedure must compute the exception and native consequence; do not delegate the complete native label or the full legal exception decision to READ. Missing rules are not defaults or invented conditions.
acquisition_contract.scope: Focus disclosure tasks nda-5 and nda-7; declare public_tasks. Other native tasks retain ordinary fallback and remain in the parent score. current_question is a literal argument, not a model read.
acquisition_contract.source_parameters: Explicitly compare the old source-specific recipient classes, safeguards, permission scope and prohibition/exception relationship to the supplied current contract. Preserve qualifications and reference scope. An old Paragraph 4 reference is not evidence for a different document.
acquisition_contract.unknowns: Do not infer unstated consent, waive conditions, substitute an absent provision or hardcode a new parent answer. No teacher-produced field labels are independent gold.

mechanism_credit.CoRev: Two pre-existing legal responsibilities, actual USE, compatible-interface complete version table establishing necessary joint revision, and later real pattern use. Creation and interface breakage do not count.
mechanism_credit.Lift: Actual current-source premise reading and binding with unchanged procedure; singleton success alone does not prove a coupling advantage.
mechanism_credit.controls: Keep independent original acquisitions, shared-rule update comparison, AllPorts and generic multi-edit memory separate; report absorption and failure.

offline_evidence: Actual generated graph, source support and USE inspected; missing directly-used singleton candidates restored without changing P, old skills or correctness checks.
reuse: After both updates freeze, execute one already-fixed other TRAIN parent once per arm, without teacher or further update; native annotations only grade it.
source_selection: Original TRAIN legal clauses, known prior TRAIN initial scores and known teacher-receipt exposure; not DEV/TEST or new-output selection.
start: Shared actual acquired Full legal graph; independent seed acquisitions separately preserved and costed.
teacher_workload: Four arms at each of two fixed update parents, no unchanged retry. Each keeps the existing three-block/three-revision/eight-parent allowance.
